quote: A completed shared receipt written by v2026.9.1 legitimately has no lifecycle companion row. On upgrade, discovery throws here (or in the missing-table branch), and `sessions.github.options` fails before returning either account choices or `pendingPersonal`.
note: The earlier “Preserve options discovery for legacy terminal receipts” item flagged a throw in shared receipt discovery when lifecycle data was missing on upgrade. The requested fix covered unbound legacy receipts, while the shipped error occurred when a bound receipt remained after idle cleanup retired its worktree.
